findings.title: Single-use/single-service articles: properly stored and used
findings.comment:
Observed plastic spoons to be stored in a cup with the food-contact surface facing upward. Discussed with PIC proper storage options. PIC rearranged spoons so that the handles faced downward. Ensure that plastic spoons are stored in a manner that protects against contamination. 

4-904.11: (A) cleaned and SANITIZED UTENSILS shall be handled, displayed, and dispensed to prevent FOOD- and lip-contact surface contamination. (B) UTENSILS not prewrapped shall be presented so only handles are touched by EMPLOYEES and/or CONSUMERS. (C) SINGLE-SERVCIE ARTICLES intended for FOOD- and lip-contact shall be furnished for CONSUMER with wrapper or APPROVED dispenser.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114 Quat solution at 3 part sink was observed at 100ppm. Solution was made around 11am with one sani-tablet. Solution was in use for ware washing and once again remade with one tablet. The freshly made solution was again observed at 100ppm. After adding a second tablet the concentration was observed at 200ppm as required by product label directions. PIC was advised to ensure use of two sanitizer tablets when preparing sanitizer solution for ware washing. 
A quaternary ammonia compound solution shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions and be maintained at the concentration as indicated by the manufacturer's use directions included in the labeling. Ensure proper concentration of 200ppm is maintained, and verify concentration with test strips.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.citation_text:
3-501.16 (A)(2) TCS foods in cold table held on an ice bath had surface temperatures at 48F-50F and internal temperatures ranging 41.5F-47F, including sliced tomatoes, deli meat, and diced chicken. Ice bath was setup around 9am, and ice slowly melted over time. Pans were not in direct contact with ice at time of inspection. PIC was advised on maintaining the ice throughout operations, with best practice of keeping ice at a depth to allow for pans to be surround on all sides and the bottom with ice. PIC was advised to check internal temperatures, and any foods at 50F/above in the cold table were to be discarded at the close of operations.
Except during preparation, cooking, or cooling, or when time is used as a public health control, cold TCS foods shall be maintained at 41F/below.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Quat test strips available for use were water damaged. Test strips were discarded. Inspector provided PIC with a few quat test strips to get through the remainder of current operating day. Business card was provided for PIC to send a photo via text or email to show availability of quat test kit prior to correct by date to show correction of the violation.
A test kit that accurately measures the concentration of sanitizing solutions in mg/L shall be provided.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.citation_text: 5-205.11  (Pf) Observed the hand washing sink to be blocked by plastic trays about to be washed. Hand washing sinks must be accessible at all times. The trays were moved during the inspection. Reference 5-205.11.
